plan.requires: Block-holdout pilot v2 finished and reported; owner approval; exact sizes and config hash recorded before any EEG is read
plan.question: With the same held-out sentences, input and training size, how much does training on sentences close in the reading order raise accuracy, compared with training only on distant sentences?

reading_order_evidence.zuco1: Paper: sentences were presented to all subjects in identical order
reading_order_evidence.zuco2: Paper: block and sentence order was identical for all subjects; normal-reading blocks alternate with task blocks
reading_order_evidence.not_verified: That sentence IDs equal presentation positions, and where block boundaries and breaks fall

split.excluded_everywhere: v2 test blocks and every sentence within 10 list positions of them; sentences that repeat in their list, occur in both releases, have a near-duplicate, or share at least 80% of the shorter sentence's tokens with another sentence
split.cluster_policy: Drop a cluster if it touches the excluded v2 test zone; remove other excluded sentences from retained clusters
split.selection_policy: In each fold and release, every third retained cluster selects settings and the others are scored
split.near_sentences: List distance 1 to 5 from the nearest held-out sentence
split.gap_sentences: List distance 6 to 10; used in no fit and no score
split.far_sentences: List distance 11 or more from every held-out sentence

training_conditions.far: All far sentences in the fold
training_conditions.near: All near sentences plus seeded far sentences, so each release has the same sentence count as the far condition
training_conditions.half_size: Seeded half of each condition, keeping its near share
training_conditions.matching: Report observation counts per condition; do not drop observations to equalize them

F.window: Whole sentence, center crop only above 30 seconds
F.normalizer: Per reader, fit on training observations only

v1.normalizer: Existing channel normalizer, fit on training observations only

cnn.encoder: Existing EEGCNN, temporal_segments 1, embedding_dim 128, settings matching v2
cnn.selection: Lowest alignment loss on selection clusters
cnn.also_reported: Last-epoch score, because v2 always selected the first epoch
arms: F input, near and far: real, gaussian and class_shuffled
F input, half size, near and far: real
v1 input, near and far: real

ridge.selection: Highest selection-cluster expected 4-way accuracy; selection pools are too small for 10-way
ridge.arms: The same arms as the CNN

controls: text from the two closest training sentences in the list

plan.no_training_analysis: Bin saved v1 validation scores by each query's list distance to its closest training sentence

evaluation.primary: Expected 10-way top-1 accuracy, CNN real EEG, F input; distractors from scored sentences of the same fold and release; chance 10%
evaluation.aggregation: Mean within reader across folds, then equal weight across 30 readers
secondary: Expected 2-way and 4-way; 24-way is dropped because ZuCo1 scored pools hold 14 or 15 sentences
evaluation.ties: A tie with the correct sentence counts as a miss

decision_rule.gain: Near minus far, paired by query
decision_rule.bootstrap: 10000 resamples; one-sided 97.5% lower bounds, taken as the 2.5th percentile, when resampling readers and when resampling sentences

outcomes.condition: Gain at least 5 points, both lower bounds above 0, far within 2 points of far noise
outcomes.label: Closeness explains most of the score

outcomes.condition: Gain from 2 up to 5 points, both lower bounds above 0
outcomes.label: Closeness explains part of the score

outcomes.condition: Gain below 2 points or a lower bound at or below 0, and near at least 12%
outcomes.label: Closeness is not the main cause

outcomes.condition: Gain below 2 points or a lower bound at or below 0, and near below 12%
outcomes.label: Inconclusive

decision_rule.conflict_rule: Any result that fits no outcome is reported as inconclusive

plan.test_policy: v2 test blocks and their buffers are never read, scored or used for fitting in this plan
plan.stop_rule: Stop after this run whatever the outcome. No extra settings or architectures under this plan.
plan.existing_output_policy: Refuse to run if the output directory exists; hash protected prior artifacts before and after
